question: Which source, dose, pool and panel mappings are recoverable for the exposed Navarro IL-10 reproduction?
decision: Qualify panel-wise animal reproduction and identify exact holds for subsequent RNA object qualification.
strongest_rival: Source or dose misidentification and mistaken mouse independence would turn source values into unsupported comparisons.
discriminator: Join ENA, BioSample, S1 and author code at experiment/library level; inspect workbook schemas and discrepancies without estimating treatment effects.
exposure_record: Paper Figures 1-7, correction, author code, S1 metadata and S4 individual values and P values were read before this freeze on 2026-11-08. No unexposed confirmation.
biological_unit: Mouse for animal panels; pool/library for main RNA; source row is traceability only.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells and technical sections are nested; main RNA has one library per condition. Animal assay overlap cannot be reconstructed from row order.
population_and_selection: Public source metadata and workbooks for aged male mouse IL-10 interventions; no new data selection based on significance.
contrast: Metadata qualification of D25K, WT and vehicle at each reported exposure; young vehicle is contextual.
endpoint: Source identities, worksheet inventory, pool counts, dose crosswalk, code-exclusion locators and feasibility decisions.
methods: Parse original XLSX with openpyxl, raw OOXML for independent S1 cell verification, XML metadata and ENA TSV; preserve disagreements and code-alias unknowns.
missingness_and_exclusions: Empty metadata rows omitted; absent fields remain unknown; no expression values or biological outcomes are filtered or estimated.
multiplicity: Not applicable to source identity and feasibility checks; no inferential tests.
precision_basis: Metadata audit has no biological effect precision claim or invented effect margin.
interpretation_limit: Successful metadata recovery cannot establish hidden donor labels, independent replication, causality or scientific acceptance.
stop_rule: Fail on malformed workbook or duplicate run; unresolved identities hold only dependent numerical contrasts.
amendment_reason: Initial exposed metadata stage after owner authorized technical execution and S1/S4 became readable.
